source:
@@U03087@@
A meteor? Whod have expected it? Its shine reveals a rounded bodily thing. I scent life. I mustn't get too close, being harmful to life. It would do my name no good and serve no purpose. It’s descending, I see. I'll be prudent now and withdraw.

@@U03088@@
(Exit. The AERONAUTS appear from above.)

@@U03090@@
[ll take another spin around Above these flames and phantoms dreary; Down there upon that battleground Things look ghostly, wild, and eerie.

@@U03092@@
In the northland’s waste I'd see Ghastly shapes and horrors rare, Here hideous ghosts appear to me, And I’m as much at home as there.

@@U03094@@
Look! That tall, gaunt figure there! Striding off, Pm sure, afraid.

@@U03096@@
She saw us riding through the air. Who can blame the frightened shade?

@@U03098@@
Let her go! Set down your knight; In this land of myth he will revive; Freed of horror and of fright, He will flourish, he will thrive.

@@U03100@@
(Touching the ground.)

@@U03101@@
Where is she?
translation:
@@U03087@@
一颗流星？谁料到会这样呢？它的光泽揭示了一个圆形的身体。我闻到了生命的气息。不能靠得太近，否则会危及生命。这对我的名誉没有任何好处，也没有任何作用。我看到，它正在下降。我现在会谨慎行事并退出。

@@U03088@@
（退出。飞行员从上面出现。）

@@U03090@@
[将在这些沉闷的火焰和幻影之上再旋转一次；在那片战场上，一切看起来幽灵般、狂野而怪异。

@@U03092@@
在北国的荒原上，我会看到罕见的可怕形状和恐怖，这里可怕的鬼魂出现在我面前，我和那里一样自在。

@@U03094@@
看！那高大、瘦削的身影！大步走开，Pm当然，害怕。

@@U03096@@
她看到我们在空中骑行。谁能责怪受惊的影子呢？

@@U03098@@
让她走吧！放下你的骑士；他将在这片神话之地复活；摆脱了恐惧和恐惧，他将会蓬勃发展，他将会蓬勃发展。

@@U03100@@
（触地。）

@@U03101@@
她在哪儿？
